column1: # The ONE fetch list for the text-fit advance table (ROADMAP O189, V1 of the font-version ruling).
# gen_advances.sh fetches the https rows, gen_advances.py prices every row, and the calibration
# harness embeds the same files: one list, so the table and its calibration cannot name different fonts.
#   slot    which pinned set the file belongs to. The table is the per-glyph maximum over every slot.
#   file    the name the generator prices it under (gen_advances.py COLUMNS and FALLBACKS).
#   sha256  the file's digest, checked before any byte of it is read as a font.
#   source  debian:<package>=<version> for a file an apt pin installs, or the https URL it is fetched from.
# Slot debian is the Debian bookworm pin and holds every file the generator prices. Slot noto-23.7.1 is
# the notofonts monthly release 23.7.1, per file from its tag; DejaVu comes from Debian only. Moving any
# row is a decision recorded in ROADMAP, and textfit/pins.py fails until the table header agrees.
# No font file enters the tree.
